channel.title: US Top News and Analysis

item.title: Anthropic IPO raises over $81 billion in largest offering on record, topping SpaceX
item.description: Anthropic stock is set to begin trading on the Nasdaq under the ticker symbol ANT on Thursday.

item.title: Russia says Putin in ‘excellent mood’ after Trump meeting, ahead of trilateral with Xi in China
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump met individually on Thursday with Russian President Vladimir Putin, as well as Chinese President Xi Jinping.

item.title: Musk accuses Zelenskyy of lying about Starshield restrictions in Ukraine
item.description: Elon Musk was asked about Zelenskyy claims over the Starshield network, and he said, "I don't want to blow your mind, but Zelenskyy is not always truthful."

item.title: Takaichi gets chilly reception in China on first Japan leader visit since 2019
item.description: Takaichi received a subdued welcome on her trip to attend the APEC summit, as Beijing shows limited appetite for repairing ties strained by Taiwan dispute.

item.title: Nvidia interim CEO Kress tells employees ‘let’s move forward’ at first all-hands meeting since Jensen Huang exit
item.description: Nvidia's interim CEO Colette Kress urges staff forward and offers pay raises after Jensen Huang exit.

item.title: I watched Trump, Xi and Putin gather in China. Here are my top takeaways
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin are expected to hold a rare trilateral meeting on Thursday.

item.title: Musk says Jensen Huang is irreplaceable, regrets midterm spending
item.description: Elon Musk spoke about Jensen Huang, his U.S. midterms spending and overlaps between SpaceX and Tesla at the Dealbook Summit.

item.title: How this hedge fund is betting on people’s fears of getting old
item.description: Hedge fund manager Kernow sees U.K.-listed Beauty Tech Group nearly tripling in value.

item.title: Van Gogh's 'Chataigniers en Fleurs' sells at auction for record $190.4 million
item.description: Vincent van Gogh's 1890 painting "Chataigniers en Fleurs," unseen in public for more than 50 years, was sold for $190.4 million.

item.title: Cantor Fitzgerald's Nvidia business interests targeted in Democrats' Lutnick probe
item.description: The congressional probe is among the first to be announced since the blue-wave midterm that will deliver Democrats control of the House and Senate come January.

item.title: The 'exceptional' dollar scenario that forced Deutsche Bank to change its FX forecasts
item.description: Deutsche Bank sees some greenback strength in the first half of next year, then modest weakness in the second half — overall the currency will stay at elevated levels.

item.title: Palo Alto inks $4.5 billion deal for AI startup Applied Compute, shares pop 7% on earnings
item.description: Palo Alto Networks has been steadily acquiring companies to capitalize on demand for cyber tools to fight AI.

item.title: 'Parasite' backer and other South Korean media, gaming and travel stocks rally on China trade deal
item.description: Korean media, gaming and travel stocks surged on hopes of greater access to China.

item.title: Kash Patel skips House hearing after Mar-a-Lago gala with $50,000 access
item.description: Kash Patel missed a congressional hearing after appearing the night before at a Mar-a-Lago gala offering donors of $50,000 access to top officials.

item.title: CEO turned informant: How the FDA built a case against executives promising cheap medications
item.description: The FDA's unprecedented criminal case against an alternative funding program hinged on the cooperation of a peer CEO, according to a court record.

item.title: Fed officials expect more rate hikes, worry about AI impact on inflation, minutes show
item.description: The Federal Reserve on Wednesday released minutes from its October policy meeting at which it voted to hold its benchmark interest rate in a range between 3.75%-4%.

item.title: Big bets against AI debt, from CoreWeave to Oracle and the Mag 7, could soon hit the ETF market

item.title: Retail investor enthusiasm for Anthropic IPO to rival SpaceX debut
item.description: Anthropic is gearing up for a blockbuster initial public offering this week, and excitement among retail investors looks to be off the charts.

item.title: Inside India newsletter: Foreign flows helped the market recover. Now it faces the inflation test
